description: This Dart source file defines an abstract interface and a concrete implementation for a task repository in a Flutter app. It interacts with Firestore to perform CRUD operations for TaskItem objects, providing stream-based and one-time fetch methods.

classes.name: ITaskRepository
classes.description: An abstract interface defining methods for real-time task streaming, fetching by ID, creating/updating, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: A Firestore-backed implementation of the ITaskRepository interface, providing concrete methods to manage tasks for a specific user.

methods.name: streamTasks
methods.description: Streams a list of TaskItem objects for a user, ordered by updatedAt descending.

methods.name: streamTask
methods.description: Streams a single TaskItem identified by its ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a TaskItem once by its ID.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a TaskItem in Firestore, returning its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by its ID.

methods.name: _requireUid
methods.description: Ensures a valid user ID is available, either from parameter or provider, or throws an error.
